From: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@saturnhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Signed SOW + request for implementation MAP

Jonas,

Thanks — we've signed the SOW (attached). We're excited to get moving. Before the kickoff we'd like a concrete Mutual Action Plan that embeds the post-signature implementation playbook: a detailed canary migration plan, stepwise rollout windows, training for our SRE and product teams, and an evaluation checklist that defines acceptance criteria.

High-level asks from our side:
- Canary approach and rollback criteria (traffic %, monitoring signals)
- Migration blackout windows and preferred dates (we have a release 2026-08-02 -> 2026-08-03)
- Training schedule for SRE + product owners (2 sessions, 90 min)
- Ownership matrix: who at Redwood owns each task

I've attached the signed order (Signed-Order-RDW-197.pdf). Please include a draft MAP and any checklists you use for canaries. Scheduling: we're aiming for a kickoff the week of 7/27.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
VP of Technology
Saturn Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:30:15 -0400
Subject: Re: Signed SOW + request for implementation MAP

Elena —

Great to see the signed SOW, and congrats to the team — we'll get you a concrete MAP today. Attached is a working draft (MAP-v1.xlsx) and a lightweight canary checklist (Canary-Checklist.pdf). Below is the proposed integrated playbook; consider this our starting point that we will convert into a shared tracker during kickoff.

Integrated MAP (summary)
- Week 0 (7/27): Project kickoff, access provisioning, baseline metrics capture. Attendees: Saturn SRE, product owner, Redwood CS (Marissa), SE (Aditya), Delivery (Ben).
- Week 1 (7/28–8/01): Environment provisioning (VPC peering / private deployment config), test data sync, eval prompt set run. Acceptance: baseline eval pass rate >= 95% on core prompts.
- Week 2 (8/04–8/07): Canary phase — progressive traffic shift:
  - Day 1: 1% production traffic, 24h monitoring
  - Day 2: 5% production traffic, 48h monitoring
  - Criteria to advance: sustained latency within SLO (p50 < 350ms, p95 < 800ms), error rate < 0.3%, no functional regressions on eval sets.
  - Rollback triggers: error spike >1%, data leakage detection, or business validation fail by Saturn PO.
- Week 3 (8/10–8/14): Migration waves — phased cutover by tenant / route with fallbacks.
- Training: two 90-minute sessions (SRE deep-dive; product/ops playbook) scheduled during Week 1 or Week 2 — we'll confirm availability.

Ownership snapshot
- Redwood: provisioning & runtime setup (Ben), SE led evals and prompt set (Aditya), CS lead for adoption and training (Marissa), Sales (Jonas) for escalation & executive cadence.
- Saturn: SRE for network/config approvals and business validation.

Next steps
1) Confirm kickoff slot: proposed 7/28 10:00–11:00 ET (please confirm or propose alternate)
2) Review attached MAP-v1.xlsx and Canary-Checklist.pdf; I'll update the Google/Confluence MAP page after our kickoff.
3) Please share a preferred point of contact for legal/procurement threads (we'll loop in Legal only if needed).

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4702192/DEAL-197), draft MAP in Confluence (link below).

Thanks — attaching the two docs now.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft MAP. We're broadly aligned. A couple of clarifications and constraints from our side:

1) Release blackout: we have a planned release on 2026-08-02 -> 2026-08-03; please ensure no migration activity during those dates.
2) Canary volume: 5% over 48h sounds fine if monitoring and rollback are automated; we'll need a runbook that shows how to trigger rollback and who owns it (Saturn PO or Redwood on-call).
3) Training: confirm two sessions — we'd like one focused on SRE (observability, KV cache behavior, troubleshooting) and another for product (prompt engineering, eval interpretation). Prefer during Week 1.
4) Legal: we'll share the DocuSign envelope for the signed SOW to Attach to procurement. Also please send the data-handling checklist that Marissa mentioned.

Kickoff: 7/28 10:00–11:00 ET works for our team. Please send calendar invite and pre-read.

Best,
